definitions.full: H5623. Sargon סַרְגֿוֺן proper name, masculine Sargon (Assyrian Šargânu , and (probably by popular etymology) Šarrukênu = firm, faithful, king see references below); — King of Assyria B.C. 722-705, conqueror of Samaria, father of Sennacherib, only Isa 20:1 ( ᵐ5 Αρνα , Aq Theod Σαραγω , Symm Σαργων [Q mg ]); Ptol Canon Ἀρκεάνου (genitive); compare Schr COT on the passage Tiele Geschichte. 238 ff . סרד (√ of following; Thes. compare Syriac be frightened ).
